name: ATICA Party Type 1 Code
definition: Type of entity acting as a Payment Initiation Service Provider.

ACCP.name: Acceptor
ACCP.definition: Card acceptor, party accepting the card and presenting transaction data to the acquirer.

DLIS.name: Delegate Issuer
DLIS.definition: Party to whom the card issuer delegates to authorise card payment transactions.

AGNT.name: Agent
AGNT.definition: Entity providing card payment processing services acting as an intermediary between an acquirer and an issuer.

ACQP.name: Acquirer Processor
ACQP.definition: Entity providing acquiring card payment processing services on behalf on an acquirer.

CISP.name: Card Issuer Processor
CISP.definition: Entity providing issuing card payment processing services on behalf on an issuer.
